title: SoftBank × Schneider Electric — €75B AI Data Centre Infrastructure Hub in France
summary: SoftBank Group committed €75 billion to build 5 gigawatts of AI data centre capacity across France, naming Schneider Electric as a primary strategic infrastructure partner. The partnership focuses on the physical AI supply chain: Schneider Electric will provide power management systems, thermal cooling, and robotics manufacturing for the first-phase site in Dunkirk — creating a centralised hardware hub to support Northern European AI scaling.

title: Checkout.com × BLIK — Direct Scheme Integration Across Central & Eastern Europe
summary: Global digital payments processor Checkout.com became a direct scheme member and official partner of BLIK, Poland’s dominant mobile payment network. The integration embeds BLIK’s native app-to-checkout protocols and newly launched recurring payment functionality into Checkout.com’s European network. International e-commerce marketplaces can now eliminate payment routing middlemen and reduce transaction friction across Central and Eastern Europe.

title: AirPlus × Kresus Technologies × Mastercard — B2B Tail Spend Automation Alliance
summary: Corporate payment specialist AirPlus International formed a tripartite alliance with European B2B fintech Kresus Technologies and Mastercard to target corporate tail spend. Kresus’s intelligent cloud payment orchestration paired with AirPlus’s corporate billing and Mastercard’s global merchant network provides European enterprises with virtual card controls to automate everyday indirect company expenses.

title: Airbus × Mistral AI — European Sovereign Deep Tech AI Deployment
summary: Airbus signed a major corporate-level deployment partnership with French AI firm Mistral AI, embedding Mistral’s full suite of generative AI models across commercial aviation, defence, space and helicopter systems. The data sovereignty strategy ensures classified military and aerospace operations run locally or via trusted European clouds rather than on US hyperscaler infrastructure.

title: Adyen × ROLLER — ROLLER Capital: Embedded Finance for Leisure & Entertainment Venues
summary: Global fintech platform Adyen partnered with ROLLER to launch ROLLER Capital using Adyen’s embedded finance infrastructure. Thousands of European and UK entertainment venues can now access fast, automated business loans directly inside their native venue management software, bypassing traditional banks.

title: Anthropic × Amazon & Google & Broadcom — Series H Infrastructure Alliances (10GW)
summary: Tied to Anthropic’s historic $65 billion Series H funding round (valuation: $965 billion), Anthropic signed multi-party infrastructure agreements: 5 GW with Amazon for dedicated energy and server capacity, and 5 GW with Google and Broadcom for next-generation TPU capacity — totalling 10 GW of dedicated AI compute.

title: Snowflake × AWS — $6B Enterprise Agentic AI Strategic Collaboration
summary: Snowflake signed a 5-year, $6 billion multi-year strategic collaboration agreement with AWS, committing to AWS Graviton and Trainium compute to accelerate enterprise agentic AI adoption. Alongside this, Snowflake announced a definitive agreement to acquire Natoma, an enterprise MCP governance platform. Snowflake stock surged 36% on the announcement day.

title: Centrica × SAP SE — Enterprise AI for Green Energy Trading & Grid Forecasting
summary: UK energy giant Centrica finalised a sweeping digital infrastructure partnership with SAP SE, integrating SAP’s Joule AI companion into Centrica’s primary corporate operations. The two companies are building unified data models to optimise green energy logistics, automate supply chain compliance, and deploy agentic AI for grid-readiness forecasting across Centrica’s European assets.

title: Snowflake × Natoma — MCP Governance Platform Acquisition for Enterprise AI Agents
summary: Alongside its $6B AWS strategic collaboration, Snowflake signed a definitive agreement to acquire Natoma — an enterprise Model Context Protocol (MCP) platform — to add an identity and governance layer for AI agents operating across enterprise workflows.

title: EY × Microsoft — $1B+ Global Enterprise AI Initiative
summary: EY and Microsoft jointly committed over $1 billion across five years to help large enterprises move AI from pilot to production. The initiative pairs Microsoft Forward Deployed Engineers with EY industry professionals across finance, tax, HR and supply chain. EY is acting as Client Zero, already scaling Microsoft 365 Copilot across its 400,000+ global staff.

title: NextEra Energy × Caliber Resource Partners — $1.3B Acquisition + Shale JV
companies: NextEra Energy, Caliber Resource Partners, Quantum Capital Group
summary: NextEra Energy agreed to acquire Caliber Resource Partners for $1.3 billion and formed a shale JV with Quantum Capital Group to manage NextEra’s US shale assets. Signals NextEra expanding beyond renewables into gas to meet AI data centre power demand. NextEra targets 15 GW for data centre hubs by 2035.

title: Anthropic × PwC — Expanded Strategic Alliance: Claude Across 364,000 Professionals
summary: PwC and Anthropic expanded their strategic alliance, deploying Claude Code and Cowork across PwC’s global workforce of 364,000+ professionals across 136 countries. 30,000 US staff will be trained and certified on Claude. Insurance underwriting compressed from 10 weeks to 10 days in production.

title: Blackstone × Skroutz — €635M Acquisition of Greece’s Leading Online Marketplace
summary: Blackstone agreed to acquire a majority stake in Skroutz — Greece’s leading online marketplace — from CVC Capital Partners Fund VII, valuing it at €635M including debt. Skroutz serves ~2.5M active users combining marketplace, last-mile logistics, fulfilment, fintech and retail media.

title: OpenAI — The Development Company: $4B+ AI Professional Services Venture
summary: OpenAI raised over $4 billion for The Development Company — a new professional services entity from a 19-firm syndicate led by TPG. The vehicle competes directly with McKinsey, Bain and Capgemini. OpenAI also acquired Tomoro for ~150 Forward Deployed Engineers.

title: Stellantis × Leapmotor — European EV Manufacturing: Chinese Tech, Spanish Production
summary: Stellantis and Leapmotor expanded from distribution JV to deep industrial manufacturing. Leapmotor B10 EV production moves to Zaragoza from 2026; a new Opel electric C-SUV using Leapmotor architecture follows from 2028. Bypasses EU tariffs on Chinese-made EVs.

title: Apple × Intel — Preliminary US Chip Manufacturing Agreement
summary: Apple and Intel reached a preliminary agreement for Intel to manufacture chips powering Apple devices — potentially M-series chips for Mac and iPad. Talks were facilitated by the US government, which holds a ~10% stake in Intel. Diversifies Apple’s supply chain away from TSMC.

title: KPMG × ServiceNow — $40M AI Agent Enterprise Transformation Partnership
summary: KPMG and ServiceNow announced a multi-year commitment with $40 million in services to accelerate AI-powered enterprise transformation. KPMG UK is one of the first large European deployers of ServiceNow AI Agents in a live environment, managing GBS workflows across HR, procurement and finance.

title: IBM × Aramco — Industrial AI Collaboration for Saudi Arabia’s Energy Sector
summary: IBM and Aramco formalised a collaboration to advance agentic AI, automation and materials science across Saudi Arabia’s industrial sector. Combines IBM’s watsonx platform with Aramco’s 90 years of energy operations data. Aramco’s AI programmes contributed an estimated $2.6B in value in 2025.

title: SAP × Prior Labs — €1B Acquisition to Build EU Frontier AI Lab for Structured Data
summary: SAP agreed to acquire Freiburg-based Prior Labs and committed €1 billion+ over four years to build a globally leading frontier AI lab. Prior Labs pioneered Tabular Foundation Models for structured enterprise data. TabPFN downloaded 3M+ times. One of Germany’s largest-ever venture exits.

title: Pentagon × 8 AI Firms — Frontier AI on Classified Military Networks
companies: Pentagon, OpenAI, Google, Microsoft, Nvidia, AWS, SpaceX, Oracle, Reflection AI
summary: The US DoD signed agreements with eight leading AI firms to deploy frontier AI on IL6 (Secret) and IL7 (Top Secret) classified networks. Emil Michael (Pentagon CTO) confirmed 1.3 million DoD personnel are already using GenAI.mil.

title: EPH × TotalEnergies — TTEP: Europe’s 2nd Largest Flexible Power Generation JV (14 GW)
summary: EPH and TotalEnergies completed a 50/50 JV creating TTEP — operating 14 GW of flexible gas, biomass and battery storage across five EU markets. EPH received ~95.4 million TotalEnergies shares (4.2% stake). TTEP has a 5 GW project pipeline for battery energy storage and flexible gas generation.
